title: Harissa Lamb Chops
description: Lamb rib chops rubbed with harissa paste and seared until charred outside and rosy within. A cool lemon yogurt and fresh mint bring everything into balance. This is a 15-minute dinner that feels like a special occasion.

steps.text: Stir harissa, 1 tablespoon olive oil, 1 tablespoon lemon juice, garlic, cumin, and salt together in a bowl. Rub the paste all over the lamb chops, coating both sides evenly. Let sit at room temperature for 15 minutes, or refrigerate up to 4 hours.
Stir together yogurt, remaining 1 tablespoon lemon juice, and a pinch of salt in a small bowl. Set aside.

Heat remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil in a large cast-iron skillet over high heat until smoking. Sear lamb chops without moving until charred on the underside, about 3 minutes. Flip and cook another 2 to 3 minutes for medium-rare (130°F internal) or 4 minutes for medium (140°F).
Transfer chops to a plate and let rest for 5 minutes. The temperature will climb another 5 degrees as they rest.
Serve chops drizzled with the lemon yogurt, scattered with torn mint, and a final drizzle of olive oil. Warm pita or couscous alongside.

inspirations.author: Andy Baraghani
inspirations.note: Inspired by BA and NYT's harissa-forward lamb preparations and the broader trend of North African flavors in quick weeknight cooking
